primary_candidate: For every reachable historical cache key K on family member t, log2 m_t(K)=o(L_t), where m_t(K) counts normalized unfolded execution contexts with byte-identical key K.
decisive_falsifier: Prove an infinite subsequence with reachable keys K_t satisfying log2 m_t(K_t) >= c*L_t for one constant c>0.

mandatory_obligations.P0_SOURCE_PROJECTION_AMBIGUITY: For K define Sigma(K) as the set of distinct source-only restricted CNFs S(A) arising from reachable contexts A with historical key K. Prove pi(K)=log2|Sigma(K)|=o(L), or prove pi(K)=Omega(L) on an infinite reachable family.
mandatory_obligations.P1_CONTEXT_NORMALIZATION: Define cumulative branch+unit assignment context canonically and prove all counted occurrences are distinct valid unfolded execution contexts.
mandatory_obligations.P2_FIXED_SOURCE_PROJECTION_MAJ3_CLASSIFI: Conditioned on one fixed source projection S, classify all MAJ3 restriction histories compatible with S exactly, including 01/10 identity collisions and full-output preimages.
mandatory_obligations.P3_FIXED_SOURCE_PROJECTION_GF2_COMPATIBI: Conditioned on S, derive exact endpoint parity/constant-flip constraints and cycle-space degrees without treating semantic preimages as reachable contexts.
mandatory_obligations.P4_SMALL_SCOPE_AND_VANISHED_FACTOR_ACCOU: Charge source-factor identity/conjunction ambiguity when residual scopes collapse to <=3 variables or source factors become tautological under restriction.
mandatory_obligations.P5_EXECUTION_REACHABILITY: Use only frozen branch/UP/local-Resolution dynamics to bound or realize representatives from P0-P4.
mandatory_obligations.P6_FIBER_COMPOSITION: Combine all ambiguity terms into an exact upper bound or an explicit exponential reachable lower bound for m_t(K).
mandatory_obligations.P7_TOTAL_ACCOUNTING: Charge theorem construction, any certificate, replay and bit complexity in original lifted input length.

safe_exact_identity: For cumulative assignment A, the source-only restricted clause set S(A) is contained in the historical key K(A) modulo canonical duplicate collapse; equality is not assumed.
fiber_partition: m(K)=sum_{S in Sigma(K)} |F(K,S)|, hence log2 m(K) <= pi(K)+max_S log2|F(K,S)|.
